subject: english
stem: Which reason does the passage give for this situation: “The guide said the rock mattered not”?
options: They thought batteries always looked like boxes filled with chemicals
Of its size, but because of where it had been
Writing by hand feels different from sending a quick message
The lamp made a small study space just for her

本文可直接核對「of its size, but because of where it had been」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Writing by hand feels different from sending a quick message」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
